items.title: The other Sean Byrne doesn't exist
items.title_zh: 另一个肖恩·伯恩不存在：身份误匹配的警示故事
items.title_en: The Other Sean Byrne Doesn't Exist: A False Identity Match Horror Story
items.summary: A personal account of being mistaken for another person named Sean Byrne, illustrating the dangerous consequences of flawed identity verification systems.

items.title: BDH-CQ: IN-CONTEXT LEARNING WITH RECURRENT LATENT REASONING [R]
items.title_zh: BDH-CQ：循环潜在推理模型突破ARC-AGI成本前沿
items.title_en: BDH-CQ: Recurrent Latent Reasoning Model Breaks ARC-AGI Cost Frontier
items.summary: Introduces BDH-CQ, a 150M-parameter recurrent latent reasoning system that achieves 29.5% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-1 at $0.00070 per task, improving the cost-accuracy Pareto frontier.
